tasks.label: see user edits
args: cd /d e:\Glossy && set GIT_PAGER=cat && git --no-pager diff --stat && echo ===== && git --no-pager diff PRIVACY.md CHANGELOG.md

tasks.label: stats tests 2
args: cd /d e:\Glossy\server && node --test test\stats.test.js test\handler.test.js test\store-file.test.js test\store-redis.test.js 2>&1 | findstr /c:"✖" /c:"tests " /c:"pass " /c:"fail " /c:"AssertionError"

tasks.label: full suite summary
args: cd /d e:\Glossy\server && node --test test\*.test.js > e:\Glossy\.tmp\all.log 2>&1 & type e:\Glossy\.tmp\all.log | findstr /c:"fail" /c:"pass" /c:"tests"

tasks.label: ship stats endpoint
args: cd /d e:\Glossy\server && node --test test\*.test.js > e:\Glossy\.tmp\t.log 2>&1 && npm run build:scf && cd /d e:\Glossy && git add server && git commit -F .tmp\commit.txt && git push origin main && git log --oneline -2 && git status -sb

tasks.label: check ship result
args: cd /d e:\Glossy && findstr /c:"fail" /c:"pass" /c:"tests" /c:"AssertionError" .tmp\t.log & echo ===== && git log --oneline -2 && git status -sb

tasks.label: list node procs
args: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='node.exe'" | ForEach-Object { "$($_.ProcessId) :: $($_.CommandLine)" } | Set-Content -Encoding UTF8 e:\Glossy\.tmp\ps1.txt

tasks.label: verify stats script
args: node e:\Glossy\.tmp\bom.js e:\Glossy\scripts\stats.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File e:\Glossy\.tmp\check.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File e:\Glossy\.tmp\verify-stats.ps1

tasks.label: rerun stats verify
args: node e:\Glossy\.tmp\bom.js e:\Glossy\scripts\stats.ps1 && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File e:\Glossy\.tmp\verify-stats.ps1 > e:\Glossy\.tmp\verify-console.txt 2>&1 & echo EXIT %ERRORLEVEL%

tasks.label: server suite after shared flag
args: cd /d e:\Glossy\server && node --test test/*.test.js 2>&1 | findstr /c:"# tests" /c:"# pass" /c:"# fail" /c:"not ok"
